text: Alice Walker's The Color Purple was challenged in 1984, when a parent petitioned against its use in an Oakland, California classroom; the Oakland schools ultimately decided not to remove the book from classrooms. In 2013 a parent challenged the book in Brunswick County, North Carolina.
meta_description: The Color Purple by Alice Walker: challenged in an Oakland, California classroom in 1984 (not removed) and in Brunswick County, North Carolina in 2013.
changes: Author and title lead; petition vs outcome kept distinct.
